evals.name: big-log-small-fix
evals.prompt: CI fails on `python tests/test_parser.py`. The CI log is logs/ci.log (about 3,000 lines) and the parser is src/parser.py (about 2,500 lines). Find the cause and fix it. Keep the context small: do not read either file whole.
evals.expected_output: The failing assertion found by grep in the log, parse_amount located by grep and read as a range, the thousands separator handled (number.replace(',', '')), test re-run green; no whole-file read of either big file.

checks.text: Every Read of a file over 200 lines used offset/limit
Size check or grep was run before reading
Neither big file was cat'ed whole

expectations: Phase 2 done: every read of a file over 200 lines was preceded by a size check or a grep and used a line range (offset/limit or sed -n), never the whole file.
Phase 3 done: no single tool result in the transcript exceeds 200 lines; the CI log was searched with grep -n -m or an equivalent and only the hit's context was read.
